basic_details.job_title: Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Programme Officer, Assistant Editor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two Level-10 posts (Rs.56,100-1,77,500, 7th CPC Pay Matrix) are open at Sahitya Akademi, an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India: one Programme Officer and one Assistant Editor, both marked UR, at the Head Office, New Delhi. The posts are to be filled on direct recruitment basis. The application is to be submitted only on the prescribed proforma available on the Akademi's website, within 21 days from the date of publication, and the notice prints 18 December 2026 as the last date.

how_to_apply: Go to the Akademi's website, https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in, where the prescribed proforma is available.
Prepare the application on the prescribed proforma. The notice says the application should be submitted only on this proforma.
Submit the application within 21 days from the date of publication. The notice prints 18 December 2026 as the last date of the advertisement.
The notice does not state whether the proforma is submitted online, by post or by email, and it names no documents to enclose.

content_sections.heading: About Sahitya Akademi
content_sections.text: Sahitya Akademi describes itself as India's premier literary institution. It preserves and promotes literature in the twenty-four Indian languages it recognizes, through awards, fellowships, grants, publications, literary programmes, workshops and exhibitions. The Akademi also undertakes literary exchange programmes with various countries to promote Indian literature abroad.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts with one vacancy each, a total of 2 vacancies, both in the UR category.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for either post. The notice says that more details, including eligibility, are on the Akademi's website, so candidates should check the official notification for the post-wise eligibility of the Programme Officer and Assistant Editor posts.
